rows.note: Use this when two things match in every detail and are indistinguishable, especially in appearance.

example.english: The people in these two photos are identical; I really can't tell which is which.
example.traditional: 呢兩張相入面嘅人一模一樣，真係分唔出邊個打邊個。
example.jyutping: ne1 loeng5 zoeng1 soeng2 jap6 min6 ge3 jan4 jat1 mou4 jat1 joeng6 zan1 hai6 fan1 m4 ceot1 bin1 go3 daa2 bin1 go3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that two things are exactly the same, including abstract equivalents.

example.english: The total on your quotation is identical to the total on our budget sheet.
example.traditional: 你份報價同我哋預算表嘅總數完全一樣。
example.jyutping: nei5 fan2 bou3 gaa3 tung4 ngo5 dei6 jyu6 syun3 biu2 ge3 zung2 sou3 jyun4 cyun4 jat1 joeng6
